name: Hamono Kaji
description: A dark, precise store theme for knife forges and kitchen-tool shops that sell chef knives, whetstones, hinoki boards and a sharpening service online: charcoal slate and forge-iron surfaces, tamahagane steel grey, warm hinoki wood for everything you can press and one restrained ember accent, large product photography on a twelve-column grid with faint column guides and thin ruled cells, giant condensed Archivo titles over Instrument Sans text with JetBrains Mono specification sheets, prices and index numbers, a numbered index-tab header that scrolls sideways on a phone and a footer with a slow ticker of knife-care tips over a ruled spec-sheet colophon, plus a forge story, a knife-care guide with a sharpening service, a monthly letter, a light Washi style variation, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.
header: index-tabs: wordmark cell left, numbered folder-tab nav in ruled cells (ember top edge on the current page), utility cell right; the tab strip scrolls sideways on a phone
footer: marquee-colophon: slow ticker of knife-care tips over a ruled spec-sheet colophon (maker, forge, hours, write) and a compact one-line sitemap

fonts.role: display: condensed titles, product names, years and the ticker
body text, leads, questions and forms

fonts.role: index labels, specification sheets, prices, buttons and tab numbers

store.withoutPlugin: The shop page lists every knife, stone, board and the sharpening service with photographs and prices, and orders by email; store templates are not used.
